scenarios.scenario_abstract: When turning a mental image into a first top, [X] chooses a simple pattern, handles candidate swatches, and makes a muslin before cutting the final cloth, comparing drape, opacity, edge behavior, stretch recovery, pressing response, and sewing control rather than choosing by appearance alone.
examples: backlighting a light or open construction before deciding whether it needs a lining
pressing and creasing a woven shirting sample to see whether it holds the intended silhouette
stretching a knit or textured sample and checking whether its edge curls or returns cleanly
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把脑中的第一件上衣变成实物时，[X]会先选择简单纸样、亲手比较候选小样并制作坯布样衣，再决定是否裁剪正式面料；判断依据包括垂坠、透光、边缘表现、拉伸回弹、熨烫反应和缝制可控性，而不只看外观。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping from Ireland for a summer trip to Italy, [X] compares chic but comfortable tops for heat, perspiration, church coverage, dinners, and repeated suitcase wear, judging each construction by airflow, cling, creasing, drying time, and how polished it remains after a long day.
examples: using a crisp open-textured shirt when airflow and presentability both matter
choosing a soft knit only when it does not cling after walking in humidity
rejecting a delicate blouse when its snag or wrinkle risk makes repeated packing unrealistic
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从爱尔兰为意大利夏季旅行选购既舒适又利落的上衣时，[X]需要兼顾高温出汗、教堂遮盖、晚餐和行李箱内的重复穿着，并通过透气、贴身、起皱、干燥速度以及一整天后是否仍显整洁来比较不同面料结构。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When comparing basic jackets at luxury and fast-fashion price points, [X] examines weave density, weight, seam stability, hardware support, surface recovery, and color retention to decide whether the more expensive construction offers meaningful everyday durability rather than prestige alone.
examples: holding both jackets to the light to compare density and weak spots
feeling whether a heavier structured weave is supported by clean interior seams
checking reviews for softening, distortion, and color loss after repeated washing
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 比较奢侈品牌与快时尚价位的基础夹克时，[X]会通过织纹密度、克重、缝线稳定性、五金承托、表面恢复和多次洗涤后的保色，判断更高价格是否真的换来日常耐用性，而不只是品牌光环。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For the same formal wedding, [X] compares a regular suit jacket with a tuxedo using continuous body fabric versus contrasting reflective facings, covered hardware, drape, evening lighting, venue, and wedding-party consistency to choose the appropriate level of formality.
examples: checking whether a smooth lustrous lapel reads correctly under evening light
keeping lapels and body visually continuous when the group wants restrained formality
judging whether texture and sheen remain coherent across the groomsmen in photographs
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为同一场正式婚礼比较普通西装外套和礼服外套时，[X]会通过衣身面料是否连续、是否使用有反光感的对比饰面、包覆五金、垂坠、晚间灯光、场地与团队一致性，决定合适的正式程度。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a Mumbai trip, [X] builds a small top rotation for the actual season across humid outdoor heat, monsoon rain, cold air-conditioned interiors, modest coverage, and inexpensive laundry, excluding constructions that stay wet, become heavy, cling, or lose shape between wears.
examples: favoring a light raised or open weave when heat and airflow dominate
keeping one soft insulating layer for aggressively cooled trains and malls
avoiding a dense slow-drying jacket during monsoon transfers
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 去孟买前，[X]会按实际季节安排精简上衣轮换，同时应对室外湿热、季风雨、空调很冷的室内、得体遮盖和便宜洗衣服务，并排除久湿、吸水后沉重、贴身或两次穿着之间容易失形的面料结构。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a Tracer cosplay around a thrifted bomber-jacket base, [X] compares candidate surfaces and scraps for how well they accept heat-applied graphics, sewn stripes, patches, paint, repeated posing, and controlled weathering before committing to the jacket construction.
examples: testing a small transfer on a scrap before applying the large back graphic
checking whether a knit or woven panel puckers around sewn stripes
bending and lightly abrading a sample to see whether paint and texture age convincingly
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 计划以二手飞行夹克为基础制作 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]会在确定夹克结构前比较候选表面与边角料能否承受热转印、缝制条纹、贴章、上色、反复摆姿势和受控做旧。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an outdoor luncheon with twenty-five golf friends, [X] turns a playful group theme into workable upper-body options, comparing polos, camisoles, tees, cardigans, and blouses by heat comfort, sheerness, trim snagging, drape while seated, and how their surfaces read in bright group photographs.
examples: using an open decorative trim only where it will not snag during lawn games
choosing a stable knit polo that stays composed while seated outdoors
checking whether a fluid dressy surface reflects too strongly in midday photographs
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位高尔夫朋友举办户外午宴时，[X]会把俏皮的团队主题转化为可穿的上装选择，并按高温舒适、透光、饰边勾挂、坐下时的垂坠以及明亮合照中的表面效果，比较 Polo 衫、吊带上衣、T 恤、开衫和女衬衫。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before machine washing, [X] reads each care label, separates delicate or open constructions from heavy jeans and towels, uses a protected cold cycle only when allowed, and inspects air-dried tops for snagging, edge distortion, pilling, stretch, or loss of texture.
examples: placing a fragile trimmed top in a protective bag only when its label permits machine washing
reducing agitation and spin for openwork or loosely knitted structures
laying a shaped or piled top flat and checking recovery after drying
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 判断标注手洗的上衣能否进入洗衣机时，[X]会逐件读取洗标，把精细或镂空结构与牛仔裤、毛巾等重物分开，在洗标允许时使用受保护的冷水程序，并在风干后检查勾丝、边缘变形、起球、拉伸或纹理流失。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While making an oil painting as a birthday gift across several sessions, [X] sets aside a work top for handling wet pigment, oil medium, solvent, brushes, and cleanup. Before reusing it, [X] checks whether its surface sheds lint, catches brush handles, absorbs spills too quickly, restricts the arms, or can be isolated from ordinary clothing without becoming cumbersome.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 分多次完成一幅生日礼物油画时，[X]会专门留出一件工作上装，用于处理未干颜料、调和油、溶剂、画笔和清理工作；每次复用前，都会检查表面是否掉绒、勾挂笔杆、过快吸收溅洒物、限制手臂活动，以及能否与日常衣物分开处理而不显笨重。
examples: using Canvas, Denim, or Twill when a dense stable surface is worth the added structure
using Poplin or Chambray when a lighter tightly woven work layer still controls lint and loose texture
avoiding loosely open Mesh, Crochet, Boucle, or highly absorbent pile when it would catch tools or retain spills

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a fifteen-day relaxation trip from India through Swiss lakes and Alpine bases, [X] chooses a compact set of T-shirts, light tops, sweaters, and one insulating layer that can move among sun, rain, cool evenings, air-conditioned trains, and periodic laundry without becoming bulky, slow to dry, or uncomfortable when stacked.
examples: using a light base construction that dries between laundry stops
keeping one low-bulk warm layer for mountain viewpoints and lake evenings
rejecting a thick surface when it crowds the suitcase or overheats under a rain shell
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从印度出发，在 15 天内游览瑞士湖区和阿尔卑斯山据点时，[X]会为阳光、雨水、凉夜、空调列车和阶段性洗衣选择精简的 T 恤、轻薄上衣、毛衣与一件保暖层，避免叠穿时臃肿、久湿或不适。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: While launching an Instagram scrub brand for medical students, a founder plans a week of content that follows candidate scrub tops through lectures and clinical practice, making airflow, movement, pocket strain, abrasion, repeated washing, and on-camera surface recovery visible over a long day.
examples: filming the same reach and bend sequence before and after clinical practice
showing whether the surface remains polished after heat, friction, and repeated pocket use
asking students to compare comfort and recovery without claiming a construction was tested when it was not
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名面向医学生创办 Instagram 手术服品牌的经营者规划首周内容，让候选手术服上衣经历课堂和临床实践，在漫长一天中呈现透气、活动、口袋受力、摩擦、反复洗涤和镜头下表面恢复。
